package.name: zed_frame_publisher
package.description: Publishes ZED 2i frames recorded by SensorFusion/zed_record.py (UVC backend) as sensor_msgs/Image (bgr8) so LVT2Calib's camera pattern node can consume them. Uses the per-frame t_offset_s from the session metadata.json to reproduce real capture timing and absolute (started_utc + t_offset_s) stamps.
